paired_comparison.interpretation: Negative combined MAE change means smaller average error on the SAME games; it does not establish profitability or statistical significance.

limitations: Models use their original pregame-locked predictions; no after-game model reruns.
Legacy combined midpoint may be derived only from two stored pregame forecasts, not postgame data.
Each player/event/stat is counted once; related player props remain statistically correlated.
Paper ROI uses actual recorded pregame prices for the model's exact direction; unavailable prices are excluded.
An unpriced opposite side is not assumed to have the stored originally selected side's odds.
A model tied with the market line has no directional selection.
Outcomes tied to the market line are pushes and excluded from hit-rate denominator.
Paper results are NOT actual placed bets and cannot demonstrate a reliable edge with small samples.
Every observed error uses a forecast saved before the scheduled game.
Original, opponent-aware and combined projections use identical settled markets.
All examples from one game date stay on the same side of the chronological boundary.
The later holdout is descriptive and is never used to select a new production model.
Player games and points/rebounds/assists/PRA are correlated; samples are not independent wagers.
No claims of probability calibration, guaranteed pick accuracy, or live model improvement.
Original-model probabilities are evaluated only against the original-model predicted direction.
The Combined AI uses a different directional forecast; its win-loss record is reported separately.
One earliest pregame eligible sportsbook quote represents each player/game/stat.
Unsettled games, tied lines, missing or invalid probabilities, and late picks are excluded.
Observed frequencies are descriptive; small buckets can vary greatly by chance.
No probability recalibration or changes to the live model are performed.

weight_research.method: Choose on earlier dates, test on later dates; 50+ training, 20+ test per market.

pipeline_health.notice: Overdue does not mean a loss; missing or delayed box scores must not be guessed.

limitations: Paper records are NOT actual placed bets or cash profits.
Every book/line for the same player and game is correlated; ROI is descriptive, not independent wagers.
Quotes and pregame projections must be saved before start; old quotes cannot be retroactively graded as locked model picks.
No real-market calibration, injury confirmation, verified primary defenders, or PrizePicks line/payout access.
Third-party completed player-game logs may lag official NBA corrections.
No real-money execution or gambling automation.
